        self.image_dir = self.project.image_dir_source
        self.supported_extensions = (".png", ".jpg", ".jpeg")
        self.image_ids = sorted(
            [
                f
                for f in os.listdir(self.image_dir)
                if f.lower().endswith(self.supported_extensions)
            ]
        )
        
        # Load session state
        self.index = self.project.session.get("last_image_index", 0)
        self.user_annotations = self.project.session.get("annotations", {})

        self.model_predictions = {}
        self.corrections_since_retrain = 0
        self.retrain_buffer = 20  # Can be moved to project config

        self.start_x, self.start_y, self.cur_rect, self.selected_label = None, None, None, None
        self.scale = 1.0

        self.label_file = os.path.join(self.project.dataset_dir, "labels.json")
        self.label_list, self.label_colors = self.load_label_list()

        self._setup_ui()
        self.master.protocol("WM_DELETE_WINDOW", self.on_closing)

        if self.image_ids:
            self.show_image()

    def on_closing(self):
        """Handle window close event."""
        self.save_session()
        self.master.destroy()

    def save_session(self):
        """Saves annotations and current image index to the project's session file."""
        print(f"Saving session for project {self.project.project_name}...")
        self.project.save_session(self.user_annotations, self.index)
        self.save_label_list() # Also save the labels
        print("Session saved.")

        self.main_frame = tk.Frame(self.master)
        self.main_frame.pack(fill=tk.BOTH, expand=True)

        # Canvas for image
        self.canvas_frame = tk.Frame(self.main_frame)
        self.canvas_frame.pack(side=tk.LEFT, fill=tk.BOTH, expand=True)
        self.canvas = tk.Canvas(self.canvas_frame, cursor="cross")
        self.hbar = tk.Scrollbar(self.canvas_frame, orient=tk.HORIZONTAL, command=self.canvas.xview)
        self.vbar = tk.Scrollbar(self.canvas_frame, orient=tk.VERTICAL, command=self.canvas.yview)
        self.canvas.config(xscrollcommand=self.hbar.set, yscrollcommand=self.vbar.set)
        self.hbar.pack(side=tk.BOTTOM, fill=tk.X)
        self.vbar.pack(side=tk.RIGHT, fill=tk.Y)
        self.canvas.pack(side=tk.LEFT, fill=tk.BOTH, expand=True)

        # Right-hand control panel
        self.control_panel = tk.Frame(self.main_frame, padx=10, pady=10)
        self.control_panel.pack(side=tk.RIGHT, fill=tk.Y)

        self._setup_model_panel()
        self._setup_label_panel()
        self._setup_button_panel()

        self.canvas.bind("<ButtonPress-1>", self.on_button_press)
        self.canvas.bind("<B1-Motion>", self.on_move_press)
        self.canvas.bind("<ButtonRelease-1>", self.on_button_release)

        self.master.bind("<Right>", self.next_image)
        self.master.bind("<Left>", self.prev_image)

def migrate_annotations(annotations):
    """Migrates old annotation format to the new structured format."""
    migrated = False
    for filename, anns in annotations.items():
        if isinstance(anns, list):
            migrated = True
            new_anns = {"objects": [], "image_tags": []}
            for ann in anns:
                # Assuming old format was bbox
                new_anns["objects"].append({
                    "type": "bbox",
                    "label": ann["label"],
                    "points": [ann["x1"], ann["y1"], ann["x2"], ann["y2"]]
                })
            annotations[filename] = new_anns

        tk.Button(btn_frame, text="Save Session", command=self.save_session).pack(fill=tk.X, pady=(10,0))

    def run(self):
        self.master.mainloop()

    def show_image(self):
        if not self.image_ids:
            self.canvas.delete("all")
            self.master.title(f"Annotator - {self.project.project_name} (No Images Found)")
            return
        filename = self.image_ids[self.index]
        img_path = os.path.join(self.image_dir, filename)
        self.orig_img = Image.open(img_path)
        self.master.title(f"{self.project.project_name} - {filename} ({self.index + 1}/{len(self.image_ids)})")
        self.model_predictions.setdefault(filename, {"objects": [], "image_tags": []})
        self.show_scaled_image()
        self.update_stats()

    def show_scaled_image(self):
        w, h = self.orig_img.size
        resized = self.orig_img.resize((int(w * self.scale), int(h * self.scale)), Image.LANCZOS)
        self.tkimg = ImageTk.PhotoImage(resized)
        self.canvas.delete("all")
        self.canvas.create_image(0, 0, anchor="nw", image=self.tkimg)
        self.canvas.config(scrollregion=self.canvas.bbox(tk.ALL))
        self.redraw_annotations()

    def on_button_press(self, event):
        if self.active_tool == "bbox":
            if not self.selected_label: messagebox.showwarning("No Label", "Please select an object label first."); return
            self.start_x = self.canvas.canvasx(event.x)
            self.start_y = self.canvas.canvasy(event.y)
            self.current_shape = self.canvas.create_rectangle(self.start_x, self.start_y, self.start_x, self.start_y, outline="cyan", width=2)

    def on_move_press(self, event):
        if self.active_tool == "bbox" and self.current_shape:
            cur_x, cur_y = self.canvas.canvasx(event.x), self.canvas.canvasy(event.y)
            self.canvas.coords(self.current_shape, self.start_x, self.start_y, cur_x, cur_y)

    def on_button_release(self, event):
        if self.active_tool == "bbox" and self.current_shape:
            x1, y1, x2, y2 = self.canvas.coords(self.current_shape)
            self.canvas.delete(self.current_shape)
            self.current_shape = None
            
            # Create annotation in the new format
            ann = {
                "type": "bbox",
                "label": self.selected_label,
                "points": [int(min(x1, x2) / self.scale), int(min(y1, y2) / self.scale), int(max(x1, x2) / self.scale), int(max(y1, y2) / self.scale)]
            }
            filename = self.image_ids[self.index]
            self.user_annotations.setdefault(filename, {"objects": [], "image_tags": []})["objects"].append(ann)
            self.increment_correction_counter()
            self.redraw_annotations()
            self.update_stats()

    def on_right_click(self, event):
        x, y = self.canvas.canvasx(event.x) / self.scale, self.canvas.canvasy(event.y) / self.scale
        filename = self.image_ids[self.index]
        
        # Logic to find and delete the clicked object
        current_objects = self.user_annotations.get(filename, {}).get("objects", [])
        for i, ann in reversed(list(enumerate(current_objects))):
            if ann["type"] == "bbox":
                x1, y1, x2, y2 = ann["points"]
                if x1 <= x <= x2 and y1 <= y <= y2:
                    if messagebox.askyesno("Delete", "Delete this annotation?"):
                        del current_objects[i]
                        self.increment_correction_counter()
                        self.redraw_annotations()
                        self.update_stats()
                    return

    def on_zoom(self, event):
        factor = 1.1 if (event.delta > 0 or event.num == 4) else 0.9
        if 0.1 <= self.scale * factor <= 5.0: self.scale *= factor
        self.show_scaled_image()

    def redraw_annotations(self):
        self.canvas.delete("annotation")
        filename = self.image_ids[self.index]
        
        # Draw user annotations
        for ann in self.user_annotations.get(filename, {}).get("objects", []):
            if ann["type"] == "bbox":
                self.draw_bbox(ann, self.label_colors.get(ann["label"], "blue"), ("annotation",))

    def draw_bbox(self, ann, color, tags, **kwargs):
        x1, y1, x2, y2 = [p * self.scale for p in ann["points"]]
        self.canvas.create_rectangle(x1, y1, x2, y2, outline=color, width=2, tags=tags, **kwargs)
        self.canvas.create_text(x1 + 2, y1 + 2, text=ann['label'], anchor="nw", fill=color, tags=tags)

    def load_label_list(self):
        if os.path.exists(self.label_file):
            try:
                with open(self.label_file, "r") as f: data = json.load(f)
                return data.get("labels", []), data.get("colors", {})
            except json.JSONDecodeError:
                print(f"Warning: Malformed {self.label_file}. Re-initializing.")
                self.save_label_list([], {})
                return [], {}
        else:
            self.save_label_list([], {})
            return [], {}
    
    def save_label_list(self, label_list=None, label_colors=None):
        os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(self.label_file), exist_ok=True)
        data = {"labels": label_list if label_list is not None else self.label_list, "colors": label_colors if label_colors is not None else self.label_colors}
        with open(self.label_file, "w") as f: json.dump(data, f, indent=4)

    def populate_label_listbox(self):
        self.label_listbox.delete(0, tk.END)
        for label in self.label_list: self.label_listbox.insert(tk.END, label)

    def add_label(self):
        label = self.label_entry.get().strip()
        if label and label not in self.label_list:
            self.label_list.append(label)
            color = colorchooser.askcolor(title=f"Choose color for {label}")[1] or "red"
            self.label_colors[label] = color
            self.populate_label_listbox()
            self.label_entry.delete(0, tk.END)

    def on_label_select(self, event):
        sel = self.label_listbox.curselection()
        if sel: self.selected_label = self.label_list[sel[0]]

    def next_image(self, event=None):
        if self.index < len(self.image_ids) - 1:
            self.save_session()
            self.index += 1
            self.show_image()

    def prev_image(self, event=None):
        if self.index > 0:
            self.save_session()
            self.index -= 1
            self.show_image()

    def predict_current_image(self):
        if not self.image_ids: messagebox.showinfo("No Images", "There are no images in the project to predict."); return
        model_name = self.active_model_name.get()
        model_path = self.model_manager.get_model_path(model_name)
        if not model_path: messagebox.showerror("Error", f"Could not find path for model: {model_name}"); return
        self.model_adapter.model_path = model_path
        self.model_adapter.load()
        filename = self.image_ids[self.index]
        img_path = os.path.join(self.image_dir, filename)
        self.update_stats("Predicting...")
        self.master.update()
        predictions = self.model_adapter.predict(img_path)
        # TODO: Update prediction handling for new data structure
        self.redraw_annotations()
        self.update_stats()

    def is_overlapping(self, box1, box2):
        return not (box1['x2'] < box2['x1'] or box1['x1'] > box2['x2'] or box1['y2'] < box2['y1'] or box1['y1'] > box2['y2'])

    def increment_correction_counter(self):
        self.corrections_since_retrain += 1
        if self.corrections_since_retrain >= self.retrain_buffer:
            if messagebox.askyesno("Retrain Model", f"{self.retrain_buffer} corrections made. Start retraining?"):
                self.trigger_retrain()

    def trigger_retrain(self):
        self.save_session()
        self.update_stats("Building dataset and starting training...")
        self.master.update()
        # TODO: Update build_dataset to handle new annotation format
        # build_dataset(self.project, self.user_annotations, self.label_list)
        print("Warning: Training pipeline needs to be updated for new annotation structure.")
        
    def update_model_dropdown(self):
        self.model_manager = ModelManager()
        menu = self.model_dropdown["menu"]
        menu.delete(0, "end")
        new_choices = self.model_manager.get_model_names()
        for choice in new_choices:
            menu.add_command(label=choice, command=lambda value=choice: self.active_model_name.set(value))
        if new_choices: self.active_model_name.set(new_choices[-1])

    def update_stats(self, status_text=None):
        if status_text: self.stats_label.config(text=status_text); return
        filename = self.image_ids[self.index]
        num_objects = len(self.user_annotations.get(filename, {}).get("objects", []))
        num_tags = len(self.user_annotations.get(filename, {}).get("image_tags", []))
        stats = f"Objects: {num_objects} | Image Tags: {num_tags} | Label: {self.selected_label or 'None'}"
        self.stats_label.config(text=stats)

            self.draw_box(pred, "yellow", ("box",), dash=(5, 3))
        # Draw user annotations
        for ann in self.user_annotations.get(filename, []):
            self.draw_box(ann, self.label_colors.get(ann["label"], "blue"), ("box",))

    def draw_box(self, ann, color, tags, **kwargs):
        x1, y1, x2, y2 = ann["x1"] * self.scale, ann["y1"] * self.scale, ann["x2"] * self.scale, ann["y2"] * self.scale
        self.canvas.create_rectangle(x1, y1, x2, y2, outline=color, width=2, tags=tags, **kwargs)
        self.canvas.create_text(x1 + 2, y1 + 2, text=f"{ann['label']}", anchor="nw", fill=color, tags=tags)

    # --- Label Management ---
    def load_label_list(self):
        if os.path.exists(self.label_file):
            with open(self.label_file, "r") as f:
                try:
                    data = json.load(f)
                    return data.get("labels", []), data.get("colors", {})
                except json.JSONDecodeError:
                    print(f"Warning: Malformed {self.label_file}. Re-initializing with empty labels.")
                    self.save_label_list([], {}) # Overwrite with empty valid JSON
                    return [], {}
        else:
            self.save_label_list()
            return [], {}
    
    def save_label_list(self, label_list=None, label_colors=None):
        os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(self.label_file), exist_ok=True)
        data = {
            "labels": label_list if label_list is not None else self.label_list,
            "colors": label_colors if label_colors is not None else self.label_colors
        }
        with open(self.label_file, "w") as f:
            json.dump(data, f, indent=4)

    def populate_label_listbox(self):
        self.label_listbox.delete(0, tk.END)
        for label in self.label_list: self.label_listbox.insert(tk.END, label)

    def add_label(self):
        label = self.label_entry.get().strip()
        if label and label not in self.label_list:
            self.label_list.append(label)
            color = colorchooser.askcolor(title=f"Choose color for {label}")[1]
            self.label_colors[label] = color or "red"
            self.populate_label_listbox()
            self.label_entry.delete(0, tk.END)

    def on_label_select(self, event):
        sel = self.label_listbox.curselection()
        if sel: self.selected_label = self.label_list[sel[0]]

    # --- Navigation ---
    def next_image(self, event=None):
        if self.index < len(self.image_ids) - 1:
            self.save_session()
            self.index += 1
            self.show_image()

    def prev_image(self, event=None):
        if self.index > 0:
            self.save_session()
            self.index -= 1
            self.show_image()

    # --- Human-in-the-Loop Workflow ---
    def predict_current_image(self):
        if not self.image_ids:
            messagebox.showinfo("No Images", "There are no images in the project to predict.")
            return

        model_name = self.active_model_name.get()
        model_path = self.model_manager.get_model_path(model_name)
        if not model_path: messagebox.showerror("Error", f"Could not find path for model: {model_name}"); return
        
        self.model_adapter.model_path = model_path
        self.model_adapter.load() # Reload the selected model

        filename = self.image_ids[self.index]
        img_path = os.path.join(self.image_dir, filename)
        self.update_stats("Predicting...")
        self.master.update()
        predictions = self.model_adapter.predict(img_path)
        user_anns = self.user_annotations.get(filename, [])
        self.model_predictions[filename] = [p for p in predictions if not any(self.is_overlapping(p, ann) for ann in user_anns)]
        self.redraw_boxes()
        self.update_stats()

    def is_overlapping(self, box1, box2):
        return not (box1['x2'] < box2['x1'] or box1['x1'] > box2['x2'] or box1['y2'] < box2['y1'] or box1['y1'] > box2['y2'])

    def increment_correction_counter(self):
        self.corrections_since_retrain += 1
        if self.corrections_since_retrain >= self.retrain_buffer:
            if messagebox.askyesno("Retrain Model", f"{self.retrain_buffer} corrections made. Start retraining?"):
                self.trigger_retrain()

    def trigger_retrain(self):
        self.save_session()
        self.update_stats("Building dataset and starting training...")
        self.master.update()
        
        build_dataset(self.project, self.user_annotations, self.label_list)
        
        retrain_thread = threading.Thread(target=self.run_training, daemon=True)
        retrain_thread.start()
        self.corrections_since_retrain = 0

    def run_training(self):
        try:
            print("Starting model retraining in background...")
            # Re-initialize manager to get fresh list before training
            self.model_manager = ModelManager()
            self.model_adapter.retrain(self.project) # Pass the whole project
            print("Retraining finished.")
            
            # Find and register the new model
            # The specific path depends on the trainer, this is an example
            new_model_path = self.model_adapter.get_last_trained_model_path()
            if new_model_path and os.path.exists(new_model_path):
                self.model_manager.register_model(new_model_path)
                messagebox.showinfo("Training Complete", f"Model retrained and new model registered: {os.path.basename(new_model_path)}")
                self.update_model_dropdown()
            else:
                messagebox.showwarning("Training Finished", "Training completed, but could not find the new model weights.")

        except Exception as e:
            messagebox.showerror("Training Failed", f"An error occurred: {e}")
        finally:
            self.update_stats()
            
    def update_model_dropdown(self):
        """Refreshes the model dropdown with the latest list of models."""
        self.model_manager = ModelManager() # Refresh manager
        menu = self.model_dropdown["menu"]
        menu.delete(0, "end")
        new_choices = self.model_manager.get_model_names()
        for choice in new_choices:
            menu.add_command(label=choice, command=lambda value=choice: self.active_model_name.set(value))
        
        # Try to set the newly trained model as active
        if new_choices:
            last_model_name = new_choices[-1] # Often the latest custom model
            self.active_model_name.set(last_model_name)


    def update_stats(self, status_text=None):
        if status_text: self.stats_label.config(text=status_text); return
        filename = self.image_ids[self.index]
        stats = f"Annotations: {len(self.user_annotations.get(filename, []))} | Predictions: {len(self.model_predictions.get(filename, []))} | Label: {self.selected_label or 'None'}"
        self.stats_label.config(text=stats)

def migrate_annotations(annotations):
    """Migrates old annotation format to the new structured format if necessary."""
    migrated = False
    for filename, anns in annotations.items():
        if not isinstance(anns, dict) or "objects" not in anns:
            migrated = True
            # This is the old format (a simple list of bbox dicts)
            new_anns = {"objects": [], "image_tags": []}
            for ann in anns:
                new_anns["objects"].append({
                    "type": "bbox",
                    "label": ann.get("label"),
                    "points": [ann.get("x1"), ann.get("y1"), ann.get("x2"), ann.get("y2")]
                })
            annotations[filename] = new_anns
    if migrated:
        print("Migrated old annotation format to new structured format.")
    return annotations

        model_path = self.model_manager.get_model_path(model_name)

        self.model_adapter.model_path = model_path

        predictions = self.model_adapter.predict(img_path)
        user_anns = self.user_annotations.get(filename, [])
        self.model_predictions[filename] = [p for p in predictions if not any(self.is_overlapping(p, ann) for ann in user_anns)]
        self.redraw_boxes()
        self.update_stats()

    def is_overlapping(self, box1, box2):

            new_model_path = self.model_adapter.get_last_trained_model_path()
            if new_model_path and os.path.exists(new_model_path):

                self.update_model_dropdown()
            else:
                messagebox.showwarning("Training Finished", "Training completed, but could not find the new model weights.")

        except Exception as e:
            messagebox.showerror("Training Failed", f"An error occurred: {e}")
        finally:
            self.update_stats()

import os
import json
import tkinter as tk
from tkinter import simpledialog, messagebox, colorchooser
from PIL import Image, ImageTk
import shutil
import threading
from src.training.dataset_manager import build_dataset
from src.model_manager import ModelManager


def migrate_annotations(annotations):
    """Migrates old annotation format to the new structured format if necessary."""
    migrated = False
    for filename, anns in annotations.items():
        if not isinstance(anns, dict) or "objects" not in anns:
            migrated = True
            # This is the old format (a simple list of bbox dicts)
            new_anns = {"objects": [], "image_tags": []}
            for ann in anns:
                new_anns["objects"].append({
                    "type": "bbox",
                    "label": ann.get("label"),
                    "points": [ann.get("x1"), ann.get("y1"), ann.get("x2"), ann.get("y2")]
                })
            annotations[filename] = new_anns
    if migrated:
        print("Migrated old annotation format to new structured format.")
    return annotations


class AnnotationApp:
    def __init__(self, project, model_adapter):
        self.project = project
        self.model_adapter = model_adapter
        self.model_manager = ModelManager()

        self.master = tk.Tk()
        self.master.title(f"HITL Annotator - {self.project.project_name}")

        # Core data structures from project
        self.image_dir = self.project.image_dir_source
        self.supported_extensions = (".png", ".jpg", ".jpeg")
        self.image_ids = sorted(
            [
                f
                for f in os.listdir(self.image_dir)
                if f.lower().endswith(self.supported_extensions)
            ]
        )
        
        # Load session state and migrate if necessary
        self.index = self.project.session.get("last_image_index", 0)
        self.user_annotations = migrate_annotations(self.project.session.get("annotations", {}))

        self.model_predictions = {}
        self.corrections_since_retrain = 0
        self.retrain_buffer = 20  # Can be moved to project config

        # UI State
        self.active_tool = "bbox" # Default tool
        self.start_x, self.start_y, self.current_shape, self.selected_label = None, None, None, None
        self.scale = 1.0

        self.label_file = os.path.join(self.project.dataset_dir, "labels.json")
        self.label_list, self.label_colors = self.load_label_list()

        self._setup_ui()
        self.master.protocol("WM_DELETE_WINDOW", self.on_closing)

        if self.image_ids:
            self.show_image()

    def on_closing(self):
        """Handle window close event."""
        self.save_session()
        self.master.destroy()

    def save_session(self):
        """Saves annotations and current image index to the project's session file."""
        print(f"Saving session for project {self.project.project_name}...")
        self.project.save_session(self.user_annotations, self.index)
        self.save_label_list() # Also save the labels
        print("Session saved.")

    def _setup_ui(self):
        self.main_frame = tk.Frame(self.master)
        self.main_frame.pack(fill=tk.BOTH, expand=True)

        # Canvas for image
        self.canvas_frame = tk.Frame(self.main_frame)
        self.canvas_frame.pack(side=tk.LEFT, fill=tk.BOTH, expand=True)
        self.canvas = tk.Canvas(self.canvas_frame, cursor="cross")
        self.hbar = tk.Scrollbar(self.canvas_frame, orient=tk.HORIZONTAL, command=self.canvas.xview)
        self.vbar = tk.Scrollbar(self.canvas_frame, orient=tk.VERTICAL, command=self.canvas.yview)
        self.canvas.config(xscrollcommand=self.hbar.set, yscrollcommand=self.vbar.set)
        self.hbar.pack(side=tk.BOTTOM, fill=tk.X)
        self.vbar.pack(side=tk.RIGHT, fill=tk.Y)
        self.canvas.pack(side=tk.LEFT, fill=tk.BOTH, expand=True)

        # Right-hand control panel
        self.control_panel = tk.Frame(self.main_frame, padx=10, pady=10)
        self.control_panel.pack(side=tk.RIGHT, fill=tk.Y)

        self._setup_tools_panel()
        self._setup_model_panel()
        self._setup_annotation_panel()
        self._setup_button_panel()

        # Bindings
        self.canvas.bind("<ButtonPress-1>", self.on_button_press)
        self.canvas.bind("<B1-Motion>", self.on_move_press)
        self.canvas.bind("<ButtonRelease-1>", self.on_button_release)
        self.canvas.bind("<Button-3>", self.on_right_click)
        self.master.bind("<Right>", self.next_image)
        self.master.bind("<Left>", self.prev_image)
        self.canvas.bind("<Control-MouseWheel>", self.on_zoom)

        self.stats_label = tk.Label(self.master, text="", anchor="w", justify="left")
        self.stats_label.pack(fill=tk.X, side=tk.BOTTOM, padx=10)

    def _setup_tools_panel(self):
        tools_frame = tk.LabelFrame(self.control_panel, text="Tools", padx=5, pady=5)
        tools_frame.pack(fill=tk.X, pady=5)
        self.tool_var = tk.StringVar(value=self.active_tool)
        
        def change_tool():
            self.active_tool = self.tool_var.get()

    def on_zoom(self, event):

        if 0.1 <= self.scale * factor <= 5.0:
            self.scale *= factor
            self.show_scaled_image()

    def redraw_annotations(self):
        self.canvas.delete("annotation")
        filename = self.image_ids[self.index]
        
        # Draw user annotations
        for ann in self.user_annotations.get(filename, {}).get("objects", []):
            if ann["type"] == "bbox":
                self.draw_bbox(ann, self.label_colors.get(ann["label"], "blue"), ("annotation",))
        
        # TODO: Draw model predictions

    def draw_bbox(self, ann, color, tags, **kwargs):
        x1, y1, x2, y2 = [p * self.scale for p in ann["points"]]
        self.canvas.create_rectangle(x1, y1, x2, y2, outline=color, width=2, tags=tags, **kwargs)
        self.canvas.create_text(x1 + 2, y1 + 2, text=ann['label'], anchor="nw", fill=color, tags=tags)

    # --- Label Management ---
    def load_label_list(self):
        if os.path.exists(self.label_file):
            with open(self.label_file, "r") as f:
                try:
                    data = json.load(f)
                    return data.get("labels", []), data.get("colors", {})
                except json.JSONDecodeError:
                    print(f"Warning: Malformed {self.label_file}. Re-initializing with empty labels.")
                    self.save_label_list([], {}) # Overwrite with empty valid JSON
                    return [], {}
        else:
            self.save_label_list()
            return [], {}
    
    def save_label_list(self, label_list=None, label_colors=None):
        os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(self.label_file), exist_ok=True)
        data = {
            "labels": label_list if label_list is not None else self.label_list,
            "colors": label_colors if label_colors is not None else self.label_colors
        }
        with open(self.label_file, "w") as f:
            json.dump(data, f, indent=4)

        self.label_listbox.delete(0, tk.END)

        label = self.label_entry.get().strip()
        if label and label not in self.label_list:
            self.label_list.append(label)
            color = colorchooser.askcolor(title=f"Choose color for {label}")[1]
            self.label_colors[label] = color or "red"
            self.populate_label_listbox()
            self.label_entry.delete(0, tk.END)

    def on_label_select(self, event):
        sel = self.label_listbox.curselection()
        if sel: self.selected_label = self.label_list[sel[0]]

    def next_image(self, event=None):
        if self.index < len(self.image_ids) - 1:
            self.save_session()
            self.index += 1
            self.show_image()

    def prev_image(self, event=None):
        if self.index > 0:
            self.save_session()
            self.index -= 1
            self.show_image()

    # --- Human-in-the-Loop Workflow ---
    def predict_current_image(self):
        if not self.image_ids:
            messagebox.showinfo("No Images", "There are no images in the project to predict.")
            return

        model_name = self.active_model_name.get()
        model_path = self.model_manager.get_model_path(model_name)
        if not model_path: messagebox.showerror("Error", f"Could not find path for model: {model_name}"); return
        
        self.model_adapter.model_path = model_path
        self.model_adapter.load() # Reload the selected model

        filename = self.image_ids[self.index]
        img_path = os.path.join(self.image_dir, filename)
        self.update_stats("Predicting...")
        self.master.update()
        
        predictions = self.model_adapter.predict(img_path)
        
        converted_predictions = []
        for p in predictions:
             converted_predictions.append({
                 "type": "bbox",
                 "label": p["label"],
                 "points": [p["x1"], p["y1"], p["x2"], p["y2"]],
                 "confidence": p.get("confidence")
             })

        user_anns = self.user_annotations.get(filename, {}).get("objects", [])
        self.model_predictions[filename] = [p for p in converted_predictions if not any(self.is_overlapping(p, ann) for ann in user_anns)]
        self.redraw_annotations()
        self.update_stats()

    def is_overlapping(self, box1, box2):
        if box1.get("type") != "bbox" or box2.get("type") != "bbox":
            return False
        x1, y1, x2, y2 = box1["points"]
        ox1, oy1, ox2, oy2 = box2["points"]
        return not (x2 < ox1 or x1 > ox2 or y2 < oy1 or y1 > oy2)

    def increment_correction_counter(self):
        self.corrections_since_retrain += 1
        if self.corrections_since_retrain >= self.retrain_buffer:
            if messagebox.askyesno("Retrain Model", f"{self.retrain_buffer} corrections made. Start retraining?"):
                self.trigger_retrain()

    def trigger_retrain(self):
        self.save_session()
        self.update_stats("Building dataset and starting training...")
        self.master.update()
        
        # TODO: Update build_dataset to handle the new annotation format
        # build_dataset(self.project, self.user_annotations, self.label_list)
        print("WARNING: Training pipeline is not yet updated for the new annotation structure. Training will likely fail.")
        
        retrain_thread = threading.Thread(target=self.run_training, daemon=True)
        retrain_thread.start()
        self.corrections_since_retrain = 0

    def run_training(self):
        try:
            print("Starting model retraining in background...")
            # Re-initialize manager to get fresh list before training
            self.model_manager = ModelManager()
            self.model_adapter.retrain(self.project) # Pass the whole project
            print("Retraining finished.")
            
            # Find and register the new model
            # The specific path depends on the trainer, this is an example
            new_model_path = self.model_adapter.get_last_trained_model_path()
            if new_model_path and os.path.exists(new_model_path):
                self.model_manager.register_model(new_model_path)
                messagebox.showinfo("Training Complete", f"Model retrained and new model registered: {os.path.basename(new_model_path)}")
                self.update_model_dropdown()
            else:
                messagebox.showwarning("Training Finished", "Training completed, but could not find the new model weights.")

        except Exception as e:
            messagebox.showerror("Training Failed", f"An error occurred: {e}")
        finally:
            self.update_stats()
            
    def update_model_dropdown(self):
        """Refreshes the model dropdown with the latest list of models."""
        self.model_manager = ModelManager() # Refresh manager
        menu = self.model_dropdown["menu"]
        menu.delete(0, "end")
        new_choices = self.model_manager.get_model_names()
        for choice in new_choices:
            menu.add_command(label=choice, command=lambda value=choice: self.active_model_name.set(value))
        
        # Try to set the newly trained model as active
        if new_choices:
            last_model_name = new_choices[-1] # Often the latest custom model
            self.active_model_name.set(last_model_name)


    def update_stats(self, status_text=None):
        if status_text:
            self.stats_label.config(text=status_text)
            return
        filename = self.image_ids[self.index]
        num_objects = len(self.user_annotations.get(filename, {}).get("objects", []))
        num_tags = len(self.user_annotations.get(filename, {}).get("image_tags", []))
        stats = f"Objects: {num_objects} | Image Tags: {num_tags} | Label: {self.selected_label or 'None'}"
        self.stats_label.config(text=stats)

This tool can help you list out the current subtasks that are required to be completed for a given user request. The list of subtasks helps you keep track of the current task, organize complex queries and help ensure that you don't miss any steps. With this list, the user can also see the current progress you are making in executing a given task.

Depending on the task complexity, you should first divide a given task into subtasks and then use this tool to list out the subtasks that are required to be completed for a given user request.
Each of the subtasks should be clear and distinct. 

Use this tool for complex queries that require multiple steps. If you find that the request is actually complex after you have started executing the user task, create a todo list and use it. If execution of the user task requires multiple steps, planning and generally is higher complexity than a simple Q&A, use this tool.

DO NOT use this tool for simple tasks that can be completed in less than 2 steps. If the user query is simple and straightforward, do not use the tool. If you can respond with an answer in a single turn then this tool is not required.

## Task state definitions

- pending: Work has not begun on a given subtask.
- in_progress: Marked just prior to beginning work on a given subtask. You should only have one subtask as in_progress at a time.
- completed: Subtask was successfully completed with no errors or issues. If the subtask required more steps to complete, update the todo list with the subtasks. All steps should be identified as completed only when they are completed.
- cancelled: As you update the todo list, some tasks are not required anymore due to the dynamic nature of the task. In this case, mark the subtasks as cancelled.


## Methodology for using this tool
1. Use this todo list as soon as you receive a user request based on the complexity of the task.
2. Keep track of every subtask that you update the list with.
3. Mark a subtask as in_progress before you begin working on it. You should only have one subtask as in_progress at a time.
4. Update the subtask list as you proceed in executing the task. The subtask list is not static and should reflect your progress and current plans, which may evolve as you acquire new information.
5. Mark a subtask as completed when you have completed it.
6. Mark a subtask as cancelled if the subtask is no longer needed.
7. You must update the todo list as soon as you start, stop or cancel a subtask. Don't batch or wait to update the todo list.

import os
import json
import tkinter as tk
from tkinter import simpledialog, messagebox, colorchooser
from PIL import Image, ImageTk
import shutil
import threading
from src.training.dataset_manager import build_dataset
from src.model_manager import ModelManager


def migrate_annotations(annotations):
    """Migrates old annotation format to the new structured format if necessary."""
    migrated = False
    for filename, anns in annotations.items():
        if not isinstance(anns, dict) or "objects" not in anns:
            migrated = True
            # This is the old format (a simple list of bbox dicts)
            new_anns = {"objects": [], "image_tags": []}
            for ann in anns:
                new_anns["objects"].append({
                    "type": "bbox",
                    "label": ann.get("label"),
                    "points": [ann.get("x1"), ann.get("y1"), ann.get("x2"), ann.get("y2")]
                })
            annotations[filename] = new_anns
    if migrated:
        print("Migrated old annotation format to new structured format.")
    return annotations


class AnnotationApp:
    def __init__(self, project, model_adapter):
        self.project = project
        self.model_adapter = model_adapter
        self.model_manager = ModelManager()

        self.master = tk.Tk()
        self.master.title(f"HITL Annotator - {self.project.project_name}")

        # Core data structures from project
        self.image_dir = self.project.image_dir_source
        self.supported_extensions = (".png", ".jpg", ".jpeg")
        self.image_ids = sorted(
            [
                f
                for f in os.listdir(self.image_dir)
                if f.lower().endswith(self.supported_extensions)
            ]
        )
        
        # Load session state and migrate if necessary
        self.index = self.project.session.get("last_image_index", 0)
        self.user_annotations = migrate_annotations(self.project.session.get("annotations", {}))

        self.model_predictions = {}
        self.corrections_since_retrain = 0
        self.retrain_buffer = 20  # Can be moved to project config

        # UI State
        self.active_tool = "bbox" # Default tool
        self.start_x, self.start_y, self.current_shape, self.selected_label = None, None, None, None
        self.scale = 1.0

        self.label_file = os.path.join(self.project.dataset_dir, "labels.json")
        self.label_list, self.label_colors = self.load_label_list()

        self._setup_ui()
        self.master.protocol("WM_DELETE_WINDOW", self.on_closing)

        if self.image_ids:
            self.show_image()

    def on_closing(self):
        """Handle window close event."""
        self.save_session()
        self.master.destroy()

    def save_session(self):
        """Saves annotations and current image index to the project's session file."""
        print(f"Saving session for project {self.project.project_name}...")
        self.project.save_session(self.user_annotations, self.index)
        self.save_label_list() # Also save the labels
        print("Session saved.")

    def _setup_ui(self):
        self.main_frame = tk.Frame(self.master)
        self.main_frame.pack(fill=tk.BOTH, expand=True)

        # Canvas for image
        self.canvas_frame = tk.Frame(self.main_frame)
        self.canvas_frame.pack(side=tk.LEFT, fill=tk.BOTH, expand=True)
        self.canvas = tk.Canvas(self.canvas_frame, cursor="cross")
        self.hbar = tk.Scrollbar(self.canvas_frame, orient=tk.HORIZONTAL, command=self.canvas.xview)
        self.vbar = tk.Scrollbar(self.canvas_frame, orient=tk.VERTICAL, command=self.canvas.yview)
        self.canvas.config(xscrollcommand=self.hbar.set, yscrollcommand=self.vbar.set)
        self.hbar.pack(side=tk.BOTTOM, fill=tk.X)
        self.vbar.pack(side=tk.RIGHT, fill=tk.Y)
        self.canvas.pack(side=tk.LEFT, fill=tk.BOTH, expand=True)

        # Right-hand control panel
        self.control_panel = tk.Frame(self.main_frame, padx=10, pady=10)
        self.control_panel.pack(side=tk.RIGHT, fill=tk.Y)

        self._setup_tools_panel()
        self._setup_model_panel()
        self._setup_annotation_panel()
        self._setup_button_panel()

        # Bindings
        self.canvas.bind("<ButtonPress-1>", self.on_button_press)
        self.canvas.bind("<B1-Motion>", self.on_move_press)
        self.canvas.bind("<ButtonRelease-1>", self.on_button_release)
        self.canvas.bind("<Button-3>", self.on_right_click)
        self.master.bind("<Right>", self.next_image)
        self.master.bind("<Left>", self.prev_image)
        self.canvas.bind("<Control-MouseWheel>", self.on_zoom)

        self.stats_label = tk.Label(self.master, text="", anchor="w", justify="left")
        self.stats_label.pack(fill=tk.X, side=tk.BOTTOM, padx=10)

    def _setup_tools_panel(self):
        tools_frame = tk.LabelFrame(self.control_panel, text="Tools", padx=5, pady=5)
        tools_frame.pack(fill=tk.X, pady=5)
        self.tool_var = tk.StringVar(value=self.active_tool)
        
        def change_tool():
            self.active_tool = self.tool_var.get()
            print(f"Switched to {self.active_tool} tool.")

        tk.Radiobutton(tools_frame, text="Bounding Box", variable=self.tool_var, value="bbox", command=change_tool).pack(anchor="w")
        tk.Radiobutton(tools_frame, text="Polygon", variable=self.tool_var, value="polygon", command=change_tool, state=tk.DISABLED).pack(anchor="w")
        tk.Radiobutton(tools_frame, text="Keypoint", variable=self.tool_var, value="keypoint", command=change_tool, state=tk.DISABLED).pack(anchor="w")
        
    def _setup_model_panel(self):
        model_frame = tk.LabelFrame(self.control_panel, text="Model Control", padx=5, pady=5)
        model_frame.pack(fill=tk.X, pady=5)
        
        tk.Label(model_frame, text="Active Model:").pack(anchor="w")
        
        self.active_model_name = tk.StringVar(self.master)
        model_names = self.model_manager.get_model_names()
        if not model_names:
            model_names = ["No models found"]
        
        initial_model_key = self.project.active_model
        initial_model_name = ""
        for key, details in self.model_manager.models.items():
            if key == initial_model_key:
                initial_model_name = details['name']
                break
        
        self.active_model_name.set(initial_model_name if initial_model_name in model_names else model_names[0])
        
        self.model_dropdown = tk.OptionMenu(model_frame, self.active_model_name, *model_names)
        self.model_dropdown.pack(fill=tk.X)

        tk.Button(model_frame, text="Predict with Model", command=self.predict_current_image).pack(fill=tk.X, pady=(5,0))

    def _setup_annotation_panel(self):
        anno_frame = tk.LabelFrame(self.control_panel, text="Annotations", padx=5, pady=5)
        anno_frame.pack(fill=tk.X, pady=5)

        # --- Object Labels ---
        tk.Label(anno_frame, text="Object Labels:").pack(anchor="w")
        self.label_listbox = tk.Listbox(anno_frame, height=8, exportselection=False)
        self.label_listbox.pack(fill=tk.X)
        self.label_listbox.bind("<<ListboxSelect>>", self.on_label_select)
        self.populate_label_listbox()
        
        label_entry_frame = tk.Frame(anno_frame)
        label_entry_frame.pack(fill=tk.X, pady=(5, 0))
        self.label_entry = tk.Entry(label_entry_frame)
        self.label_entry.pack(fill=tk.X, side=tk.LEFT, expand=True)
        tk.Button(label_entry_frame, text="+", command=self.add_label).pack(side=tk.RIGHT)
        
        tk.Button(anno_frame, text="Apply as Image Tag", command=self.apply_image_tag).pack(fill=tk.X, pady=(5,0))

        # --- Image Tags ---
        tk.Label(anno_frame, text="Image Tags:").pack(anchor="w", pady=(10,0))
        self.tag_listbox = tk.Listbox(anno_frame, height=4, exportselection=False)
        self.tag_listbox.pack(fill=tk.X)
        self.tag_listbox.bind("<Button-3>", self.on_tag_right_click)

    def apply_image_tag(self):
        if not self.selected_label:
            messagebox.showwarning("No Label", "Select a label from the 'Object Labels' list first.")
            return
        
        filename = self.image_ids[self.index]
        self.user_annotations.setdefault(filename, {"objects": [], "image_tags": []})
        
        current_tags = self.user_annotations[filename]["image_tags"]
        if self.selected_label not in current_tags:
            current_tags.append(self.selected_label)
            self.update_tag_listbox()
            self.update_stats()

    def on_tag_right_click(self, event):
        try:
            selected_index = self.tag_listbox.nearest(event.y)
            self.tag_listbox.selection_clear(0, tk.END)
            self.tag_listbox.selection_set(selected_index)
            selected_tag = self.tag_listbox.get(selected_index)
            
            if messagebox.askyesno("Delete Tag", f"Delete the image tag '{selected_tag}'?"):
                filename = self.image_ids[self.index]
                self.user_annotations[filename]["image_tags"].remove(selected_tag)
                self.update_tag_listbox()
                self.update_stats()
        except tk.TclError:
            # Click was not on an item
            pass
            
    def update_tag_listbox(self):
        self.tag_listbox.delete(0, tk.END)
        filename = self.image_ids[self.index]
        current_tags = self.user_annotations.get(filename, {}).get("image_tags", [])
        for tag in sorted(current_tags):
            self.tag_listbox.insert(tk.END, tag)
        
    def _setup_button_panel(self):
        btn_frame = tk.LabelFrame(self.control_panel, text="Navigation", padx=5, pady=5)
        btn_frame.pack(fill=tk.X, pady=5)
        tk.Button(btn_frame, text="Prev Image", command=self.prev_image).pack(fill=tk.X)
        tk.Button(btn_frame, text="Next Image", command=self.next_image).pack(fill=tk.X)
        tk.Button(btn_frame, text="Save Session", command=self.save_session).pack(fill=tk.X, pady=(10,0))


    def run(self):
        self.master.mainloop()

    # --- Image and Annotation Loading ---
    def show_image(self):
        if not self.image_ids:
            self.canvas.delete("all")
            self.master.title(f"Annotator - {self.project.project_name} (No Images Found)")
            return

        filename = self.image_ids[self.index]
        img_path = os.path.join(self.image_dir, filename)
        self.orig_img = Image.open(img_path)
        self.master.title(
            f"{self.project.project_name} - {filename} ({self.index + 1}/{len(self.image_ids)})"
        )
        self.model_predictions.setdefault(filename, {"objects": [], "image_tags": []})
        self.show_scaled_image()
        self.update_stats()
        self.update_tag_listbox()

    def show_scaled_image(self):
        w, h = self.orig_img.size
        new_size = (int(w * self.scale), int(h * self.scale))
        resized = self.orig_img.resize(new_size, Image.LANCZOS)
        self.tkimg = ImageTk.PhotoImage(resized)
        self.canvas.delete("all")
        self.canvas.create_image(0, 0, anchor="nw", image=self.tkimg)
        self.canvas.config(scrollregion=self.canvas.bbox(tk.ALL))
        self.redraw_annotations()

    # --- Drawing and UI Interaction (Mostly unchanged) ---
    def on_button_press(self, event):
        if not self.selected_label:
            messagebox.showwarning("No Label", "Please select a label first.")
            return
        self.start_x = self.canvas.canvasx(event.x)
        self.start_y = self.canvas.canvasy(event.y)
        self.current_shape = self.canvas.create_rectangle(self.start_x, self.start_y, self.start_x, self.start_y, outline="cyan", width=2)

    def on_move_press(self, event):
        if self.active_tool == "bbox" and self.current_shape:
            cur_x, cur_y = self.canvas.canvasx(event.x), self.canvas.canvasy(event.y)
            self.canvas.coords(self.current_shape, self.start_x, self.start_y, cur_x, cur_y)

    def on_button_release(self, event):
        if self.active_tool == "bbox" and self.current_shape:
            x1, y1, x2, y2 = self.canvas.coords(self.current_shape)
            self.canvas.delete(self.current_shape)
            self.current_shape = None
            
            # Create annotation in the new format
            ann = {
                "type": "bbox",
                "label": self.selected_label,
                "points": [int(min(x1, x2) / self.scale), int(min(y1, y2) / self.scale), int(max(x1, x2) / self.scale), int(max(y1, y2) / self.scale)]
            }
            filename = self.image_ids[self.index]
            self.user_annotations.setdefault(filename, {"objects": [], "image_tags": []})["objects"].append(ann)
            self.increment_correction_counter()
            self.redraw_annotations()
            self.update_stats()

    def on_right_click(self, event):
        x, y = self.canvas.canvasx(event.x) / self.scale, self.canvas.canvasy(event.y) / self.scale
        filename = self.image_ids[self.index]
        
        # Check user annotations
        current_objects = self.user_annotations.get(filename, {}).get("objects", [])
        for i, ann in reversed(list(enumerate(current_objects))):
            if ann["type"] == "bbox":
                x1, y1, x2, y2 = ann["points"]
                if x1 <= x <= x2 and y1 <= y <= y2:
                    if messagebox.askyesno("Delete", f"Delete this '{ann['label']}' annotation?"):
                        del current_objects[i]
                        self.increment_correction_counter()
                        self.redraw_annotations()
                        self.update_stats()
                    return
        
        # TODO: Update logic for accepting/rejecting model predictions
        # Check model predictions
        # for i, pred in reversed(list(enumerate(self.model_predictions.get(filename, [])))):
        #     if pred["x1"] <= x <= pred["x2"] and pred["y1"] <= y <= pred["y2"]:
        #         if messagebox.askyesno("Accept Prediction", f"Accept this '{pred['label']}' prediction?"):
        #             # Convert prediction to the new annotation format
        #             self.user_annotations.setdefault(filename, {"objects": [], "image_tags": []})["objects"].append(pred)
        #             del self.model_predictions[filename][i]
        #             self.increment_correction_counter()
        #             self.redraw_annotations()
        #             self.update_stats()
        #         return

    def on_zoom(self, event):
        factor = 1.1 if (event.delta > 0 or event.num == 4) else 0.9
        if 0.1 <= self.scale * factor <= 5.0:
            self.scale *= factor
            self.show_scaled_image()

    def redraw_annotations(self):
        self.canvas.delete("annotation")
        filename = self.image_ids[self.index]
        
        # Draw user annotations
        for ann in self.user_annotations.get(filename, {}).get("objects", []):
            if ann["type"] == "bbox":
                self.draw_bbox(ann, self.label_colors.get(ann["label"], "blue"), ("annotation",))
        
        # TODO: Draw model predictions

    def draw_bbox(self, ann, color, tags, **kwargs):
        x1, y1, x2, y2 = [p * self.scale for p in ann["points"]]
        self.canvas.create_rectangle(x1, y1, x2, y2, outline=color, width=2, tags=tags, **kwargs)
        self.canvas.create_text(x1 + 2, y1 + 2, text=ann['label'], anchor="nw", fill=color, tags=tags)

    # --- Label Management ---
    def load_label_list(self):
        if os.path.exists(self.label_file):
            with open(self.label_file, "r") as f:
                try:
                    data = json.load(f)
                    return data.get("labels", []), data.get("colors", {})
                except json.JSONDecodeError:
                    print(f"Warning: Malformed {self.label_file}. Re-initializing with empty labels.")
                    self.save_label_list([], {}) # Overwrite with empty valid JSON
                    return [], {}
        else:
            self.save_label_list([], {}) # Pass defaults to create the file
            return [], {}
    
    def save_label_list(self, label_list=None, label_colors=None):
        os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(self.label_file), exist_ok=True)
        data = {
            "labels": label_list if label_list is not None else self.label_list,
            "colors": label_colors if label_colors is not None else self.label_colors
        }
        with open(self.label_file, "w") as f:
            json.dump(data, f, indent=4)

    def populate_label_listbox(self):
        self.label_listbox.delete(0, tk.END)
        for label in self.label_list: self.label_listbox.insert(tk.END, label)

    def add_label(self):
        label = self.label_entry.get().strip()
        if label and label not in self.label_list:
            self.label_list.append(label)
            color = colorchooser.askcolor(title=f"Choose color for {label}")[1]
            self.label_colors[label] = color or "red"
            self.populate_label_listbox()
            self.label_entry.delete(0, tk.END)

    def on_label_select(self, event):
        sel = self.label_listbox.curselection()
        if sel: self.selected_label = self.label_list[sel[0]]

    # --- Navigation ---
    def next_image(self, event=None):
        if self.index < len(self.image_ids) - 1:
            self.save_session()
            self.index += 1
            self.show_image()

    def prev_image(self, event=None):
        if self.index > 0:
            self.save_session()
            self.index -= 1
            self.show_image()

    # --- Human-in-the-Loop Workflow ---
    def predict_current_image(self):
        if not self.image_ids:
            messagebox.showinfo("No Images", "There are no images in the project to predict.")
            return

        model_name = self.active_model_name.get()
        model_path = self.model_manager.get_model_path(model_name)
        if not model_path: messagebox.showerror("Error", f"Could not find path for model: {model_name}"); return
        
        self.model_adapter.model_path = model_path
        self.model_adapter.load() # Reload the selected model

        filename = self.image_ids[self.index]
        img_path = os.path.join(self.image_dir, filename)
        self.update_stats("Predicting...")
        self.master.update()
        
        predictions = self.model_adapter.predict(img_path)
        
        converted_predictions = []
        for p in predictions:
             converted_predictions.append({
                 "type": "bbox",
                 "label": p["label"],
                 "points": [p["x1"], p["y1"], p["x2"], p["y2"]],
                 "confidence": p.get("confidence")
             })

        user_anns = self.user_annotations.get(filename, {}).get("objects", [])
        self.model_predictions[filename] = [p for p in converted_predictions if not any(self.is_overlapping(p, ann) for ann in user_anns)]
        self.redraw_annotations()
        self.update_stats()

    def is_overlapping(self, box1, box2):
        if box1.get("type") != "bbox" or box2.get("type") != "bbox":
            return False
        x1, y1, x2, y2 = box1["points"]
        ox1, oy1, ox2, oy2 = box2["points"]
        return not (x2 < ox1 or x1 > ox2 or y2 < oy1 or y1 > oy2)

    def increment_correction_counter(self):
        self.corrections_since_retrain += 1
        if self.corrections_since_retrain >= self.retrain_buffer:
            if messagebox.askyesno("Retrain Model", f"{self.retrain_buffer} corrections made. Start retraining?"):
                self.trigger_retrain()

    def trigger_retrain(self):
        self.save_session()
        self.update_stats("Building dataset and starting training...")
        self.master.update()
        
        # TODO: Update build_dataset to handle the new annotation format
        # build_dataset(self.project, self.user_annotations, self.label_list)
        print("WARNING: Training pipeline is not yet updated for the new annotation structure. Training will likely fail.")
        
        retrain_thread = threading.Thread(target=self.run_training, daemon=True)
        retrain_thread.start()
        self.corrections_since_retrain = 0

    def run_training(self):
        try:
            print("Starting model retraining in background...")
            # Re-initialize manager to get fresh list before training
            self.model_manager = ModelManager()
            self.model_adapter.retrain(self.project) # Pass the whole project
            print("Retraining finished.")
            
            # Find and register the new model
            # The specific path depends on the trainer, this is an example
            new_model_path = self.model_adapter.get_last_trained_model_path()
            if new_model_path and os.path.exists(new_model_path):
                self.model_manager.register_model(new_model_path)
                messagebox.showinfo("Training Complete", f"Model retrained and new model registered: {os.path.basename(new_model_path)}")
                self.update_model_dropdown()
            else:
                messagebox.showwarning("Training Finished", "Training completed, but could not find the new model weights.")

        except Exception as e:
            messagebox.showerror("Training Failed", f"An error occurred: {e}")
        finally:
            self.update_stats()
            
    def update_model_dropdown(self):
        """Refreshes the model dropdown with the latest list of models."""
        self.model_manager = ModelManager() # Refresh manager
        menu = self.model_dropdown["menu"]
        menu.delete(0, "end")
        new_choices = self.model_manager.get_model_names()
        for choice in new_choices:
            menu.add_command(label=choice, command=lambda value=choice: self.active_model_name.set(value))
        
        # Try to set the newly trained model as active
        if new_choices:
            last_model_name = new_choices[-1] # Often the latest custom model
            self.active_model_name.set(last_model_name)


    def update_stats(self, status_text=None):
        if status_text:
            self.stats_label.config(text=status_text)
            return
        filename = self.image_ids[self.index]
        num_objects = len(self.user_annotations.get(filename, {}).get("objects", []))
        num_tags = len(self.user_annotations.get(filename, {}).get("image_tags", []))
        stats = f"Objects: {num_objects} | Image Tags: {num_tags} | Label: {self.selected_label or 'None'}"
        self.stats_label.config(text=stats)

def __init__(self, project, model_adapter):
        self.project = project
        self.model_adapter = model_adapter
        self.model_manager = ModelManager()

        self.master = tk.Tk()
        self.master.title(f"HITL Annotator - {self.project.project_name}")

        # Core data structures from project
        self.image_dir = self.project.image_dir_source
        self.supported_extensions = (".png", ".jpg", ".jpeg")
        self.image_ids = sorted(
            [
                f
                for f in os.listdir(self.image_dir)
                if f.lower().endswith(self.supported_extensions)
            ]
        )
        
        # Load session state and migrate if necessary
        self.index = self.project.session.get("last_image_index", 0)
        self.user_annotations = migrate_annotations(self.project.session.get("annotations", {}))

        self.model_predictions = {}
        self.corrections_since_retrain = 0
        self.retrain_buffer = 20  # Can be moved to project config

        # UI State
        self.active_tool = "bbox" # Default tool
        self.start_x, self.start_y, self.current_shape, self.selected_label = None, None, None, None
        self.scale = 1.0

        self.label_file = os.path.join(self.project.dataset_dir, "labels.json")
        self.label_list, self.label_colors = self.load_label_list()

        self._setup_ui()
        self.master.protocol("WM_DELETE_WINDOW", self.on_closing)

        if self.image_ids:
            self.show_image()

    def on_closing(self):
        """Handle window close event."""
        self.save_session()
        self.master.destroy()

    def save_session(self):
        """Saves annotations and current image index to the project's session file."""
        print(f"Saving session for project {self.project.project_name}...")
        self.project.save_session(self.user_annotations, self.index)
        self.save_label_list() # Also save the labels
        print("Session saved.")

    def _setup_ui(self):
        self.main_frame = tk.Frame(self.master)
        self.main_frame.pack(fill=tk.BOTH, expand=True)

        # Canvas for image
        self.canvas_frame = tk.Frame(self.main_frame)
        self.canvas_frame.pack(side=tk.LEFT, fill=tk.BOTH, expand=True)
        self.canvas = tk.Canvas(self.canvas_frame, cursor="cross")
        self.hbar = tk.Scrollbar(self.canvas_frame, orient=tk.HORIZONTAL, command=self.canvas.xview)
        self.vbar = tk.Scrollbar(self.canvas_frame, orient=tk.VERTICAL, command=self.canvas.yview)
        self.canvas.config(xscrollcommand=self.hbar.set, yscrollcommand=self.vbar.set)
        self.hbar.pack(side=tk.BOTTOM, fill=tk.X)
        self.vbar.pack(side=tk.RIGHT, fill=tk.Y)
        self.canvas.pack(side=tk.LEFT, fill=tk.BOTH, expand=True)

        # Right-hand control panel
        self.control_panel = tk.Frame(self.main_frame, padx=10, pady=10)
        self.control_panel.pack(side=tk.RIGHT, fill=tk.Y)

        self._setup_tools_panel()
        self._setup_model_panel()
        self._setup_annotation_panel()
        self._setup_button_panel()

        # Bindings
        self.canvas.bind("<ButtonPress-1>", self.on_button_press)
        self.canvas.bind("<B1-Motion>", self.on_move_press)
        self.canvas.bind("<ButtonRelease-1>", self.on_button_release)
        self.canvas.bind("<Button-3>", self.on_right_click)
        self.master.bind("<Right>", self.next_image)
        self.master.bind("<Left>", self.prev_image)
        self.canvas.bind("<Control-MouseWheel>", self.on_zoom)

        self.stats_label = tk.Label(self.master, text="", anchor="w", justify="left")
        self.stats_label.pack(fill=tk.X, side=tk.BOTTOM, padx=10)

    def _setup_tools_panel(self):
        tools_frame = tk.LabelFrame(self.control_panel, text="Tools", padx=5, pady=5)
        tools_frame.pack(fill=tk.X, pady=5)
        self.tool_var = tk.StringVar(value=self.active_tool)
        
        def change_tool():
            self.active_tool = self.tool_var.get()
            print(f"Switched to {self.active_tool} tool.")

        tk.Radiobutton(tools_frame, text="Bounding Box", variable=self.tool_var, value="bbox", command=change_tool).pack(anchor="w")
        tk.Radiobutton(tools_frame, text="Polygon", variable=self.tool_var, value="polygon", command=change_tool, state=tk.DISABLED).pack(anchor="w")
        tk.Radiobutton(tools_frame, text="Keypoint", variable=self.tool_var, value="keypoint", command=change_tool, state=tk.DISABLED).pack(anchor="w")
        
    def _setup_model_panel(self):
        model_frame = tk.LabelFrame(self.control_panel, text="Model Control", padx=5, pady=5)
        model_frame.pack(fill=tk.X, pady=5)
        
        tk.Label(model_frame, text="Active Model:").pack(anchor="w")
        
        self.active_model_name = tk.StringVar(self.master)
        model_names = self.model_manager.get_model_names()
        if not model_names:
            model_names = ["No models found"]
        
        initial_model_key = self.project.active_model
        initial_model_name = ""
        for key, details in self.model_manager.models.items():
            if key == initial_model_key:
                initial_model_name = details['name']
                break
        
        self.active_model_name.set(initial_model_name if initial_model_name in model_names else model_names[0])
        
        self.model_dropdown = tk.OptionMenu(model_frame, self.active_model_name, *model_names)
        self.model_dropdown.pack(fill=tk.X)

        tk.Button(model_frame, text="Predict with Model", command=self.predict_current_image).pack(fill=tk.X, pady=(5,0))

    def _setup_annotation_panel(self):
        anno_frame = tk.LabelFrame(self.control_panel, text="Annotations", padx=5, pady=5)
        anno_frame.pack(fill=tk.X, pady=5)

        # --- Object Labels ---
        tk.Label(anno_frame, text="Object Labels:").pack(anchor="w")
        self.label_listbox = tk.Listbox(anno_frame, height=8, exportselection=False)
        self.label_listbox.pack(fill=tk.X)
        self.label_listbox.bind("<<ListboxSelect>>", self.on_label_select)
        self.populate_label_listbox()
        
        label_entry_frame = tk.Frame(anno_frame)
        label_entry_frame.pack(fill=tk.X, pady=(5, 0))
        self.label_entry = tk.Entry(label_entry_frame)
        self.label_entry.pack(fill=tk.X, side=tk.LEFT, expand=True)
        tk.Button(label_entry_frame, text="+", command=self.add_label).pack(side=tk.RIGHT)
        
        tk.Button(anno_frame, text="Apply as Image Tag", command=self.apply_image_tag).pack(fill=tk.X, pady=(5,0))

        # --- Image Tags ---
        tk.Label(anno_frame, text="Image Tags:").pack(anchor="w", pady=(10,0))
        self.tag_listbox = tk.Listbox(anno_frame, height=4, exportselection=False)
        self.tag_listbox.pack(fill=tk.X)
        self.tag_listbox.bind("<Button-3>", self.on_tag_right_click)

    def apply_image_tag(self):
        if not self.selected_label:
            messagebox.showwarning("No Label", "Select a label from the 'Object Labels' list first.")
            return
        
        filename = self.image_ids[self.index]
        self.user_annotations.setdefault(filename, {"objects": [], "image_tags": []})
        
        current_tags = self.user_annotations[filename]["image_tags"]
        if self.selected_label not in current_tags:
            current_tags.append(self.selected_label)
            self.update_tag_listbox()
            self.update_stats()

    def on_tag_right_click(self, event):
        try:
            selected_index = self.tag_listbox.nearest(event.y)
            self.tag_listbox.selection_clear(0, tk.END)
            self.tag_listbox.selection_set(selected_index)
            selected_tag = self.tag_listbox.get(selected_index)
            
            if messagebox.askyesno("Delete Tag", f"Delete the image tag '{selected_tag}'?"):
                filename = self.image_ids[self.index]
                self.user_annotations[filename]["image_tags"].remove(selected_tag)
                self.update_tag_listbox()
                self.update_stats()
        except tk.TclError:
            # Click was not on an item
            pass
            
    def update_tag_listbox(self):
        self.tag_listbox.delete(0, tk.END)
        filename = self.image_ids[self.index]
        current_tags = self.user_annotations.get(filename, {}).get("image_tags", [])
        for tag in sorted(current_tags):
            self.tag_listbox.insert(tk.END, tag)
        
    def _setup_button_panel(self):
        btn_frame = tk.LabelFrame(self.control_panel, text="Navigation", padx=5, pady=5)
        btn_frame.pack(fill=tk.X, pady=5)
        tk.Button(btn_frame, text="Prev Image", command=self.prev_image).pack(fill=tk.X)
        tk.Button(btn_frame, text="Next Image", command=self.next_image).pack(fill=tk.X)
        tk.Button(btn_frame, text="Save Session", command=self.save_session).pack(fill=tk.X, pady=(10,0))


    def run(self):
        self.master.mainloop()

    # --- Image and Annotation Loading ---
    def show_image(self):
        if not self.image_ids:
            self.canvas.delete("all")
            self.master.title(f"Annotator - {self.project.project_name} (No Images Found)")
            return

        filename = self.image_ids[self.index]
        img_path = os.path.join(self.image_dir, filename)
        self.orig_img = Image.open(img_path)
        self.master.title(
            f"{self.project.project_name} - {filename} ({self.index + 1}/{len(self.image_ids)})"
        )
        self.model_predictions.setdefault(filename, {"objects": [], "image_tags": []})
        self.show_scaled_image()
        self.update_stats()
        self.update_tag_listbox()

    def show_scaled_image(self):
        w, h = self.orig_img.size
        new_size = (int(w * self.scale), int(h * self.scale))
        resized = self.orig_img.resize(new_size, Image.LANCZOS)
        self.tkimg = ImageTk.PhotoImage(resized)
        self.canvas.delete("all")
        self.canvas.create_image(0, 0, anchor="nw", image=self.tkimg)
        self.canvas.config(scrollregion=self.canvas.bbox(tk.ALL))
        self.redraw_annotations()

    # --- Drawing and UI Interaction (Mostly unchanged) ---
    def on_button_press(self, event):
        if not self.selected_label:
            messagebox.showwarning("No Label", "Please select a label first.")
            return
        self.start_x = self.canvas.canvasx(event.x)
        self.start_y = self.canvas.canvasy(event.y)
        self.current_shape = self.canvas.create_rectangle(self.start_x, self.start_y, self.start_x, self.start_y, outline="cyan", width=2)

    def on_move_press(self, event):
        if self.active_tool == "bbox" and self.current_shape:
            cur_x, cur_y = self.canvas.canvasx(event.x), self.canvas.canvasy(event.y)
            self.canvas.coords(self.current_shape, self.start_x, self.start_y, cur_x, cur_y)

    def on_button_release(self, event):
        if self.active_tool == "bbox" and self.current_shape:
            x1, y1, x2, y2 = self.canvas.coords(self.current_shape)
            self.canvas.delete(self.current_shape)
            self.current_shape = None
            
            # Create annotation in the new format
            ann = {
                "type": "bbox",
                "label": self.selected_label,
                "points": [int(min(x1, x2) / self.scale), int(min(y1, y2) / self.scale), int(max(x1, x2) / self.scale), int(max(y1, y2) / self.scale)]
            }
            filename = self.image_ids[self.index]
            self.user_annotations.setdefault(filename, {"objects": [], "image_tags": []})["objects"].append(ann)
            self.increment_correction_counter()
            self.redraw_annotations()
            self.update_stats()

    def on_right_click(self, event):
        x, y = self.canvas.canvasx(event.x) / self.scale, self.canvas.canvasy(event.y) / self.scale
        filename = self.image_ids[self.index]
        
        # Check user annotations
        current_objects = self.user_annotations.get(filename, {}).get("objects", [])
        for i, ann in reversed(list(enumerate(current_objects))):
            if ann["type"] == "bbox":
                x1, y1, x2, y2 = ann["points"]
                if x1 <= x <= x2 and y1 <= y <= y2:
                    if messagebox.askyesno("Delete", f"Delete this '{ann['label']}' annotation?"):
                        del current_objects[i]
                        self.increment_correction_counter()
                        self.redraw_annotations()
                        self.update_stats()
                    return
        
        # TODO: Update logic for accepting/rejecting model predictions
        # Check model predictions
        # for i, pred in reversed(list(enumerate(self.model_predictions.get(filename, [])))):
        #     if pred["x1"] <= x <= pred["x2"] and pred["y1"] <= y <= pred["y2"]:
        #         if messagebox.askyesno("Accept Prediction", f"Accept this '{pred['label']}' prediction?"):
        #             # Convert prediction to the new annotation format
        #             self.user_annotations.setdefault(filename, {"objects": [], "image_tags": []})["objects"].append(pred)
        #             del self.model_predictions[filename][i]
        #             self.increment_correction_counter()
        #             self.redraw_annotations()
        #             self.update_stats()
        #         return

    def on_zoom(self, event):
        factor = 1.1 if (event.delta > 0 or event.num == 4) else 0.9
        if 0.1 <= self.scale * factor <= 5.0:
            self.scale *= factor
            self.show_scaled_image()

    def redraw_annotations(self):
        self.canvas.delete("annotation")
        filename = self.image_ids[self.index]
        
        # Draw user annotations
        for ann in self.user_annotations.get(filename, {}).get("objects", []):
            if ann["type"] == "bbox":
                self.draw_bbox(ann, self.label_colors.get(ann["label"], "blue"), ("annotation",))
        
        # TODO: Draw model predictions

    def draw_bbox(self, ann, color, tags, **kwargs):
        x1, y1, x2, y2 = [p * self.scale for p in ann["points"]]
        self.canvas.create_rectangle(x1, y1, x2, y2, outline=color, width=2, tags=tags, **kwargs)
        self.canvas.create_text(x1 + 2, y1 + 2, text=ann['label'], anchor="nw", fill=color, tags=tags)

    # --- Label Management ---

    def apply_image_tag(self):
        if not self.selected_label:
            messagebox.showwarning("No Label", "Select a label from the 'Object Labels' list first.")
            return
        
        filename = self.image_ids[self.index]
        self.user_annotations.setdefault(filename, {"objects": [], "image_tags": []})
        
        current_tags = self.user_annotations[filename]["image_tags"]
        if self.selected_label not in current_tags:
            current_tags.append(self.selected_label)
            self.update_tag_listbox()
            self.update_stats()

        try:
            selected_index = self.tag_listbox.nearest(event.y)
            self.tag_listbox.selection_clear(0, tk.END)
            self.tag_listbox.selection_set(selected_index)
            selected_tag = self.tag_listbox.get(selected_index)
            
            if messagebox.askyesno("Delete Tag", f"Delete the image tag '{selected_tag}'?"):
                filename = self.image_ids[self.index]
                self.user_annotations[filename]["image_tags"].remove(selected_tag)
                self.update_tag_listbox()
                self.update_stats()
        except tk.TclError:
            # Click was not on an item
            pass

        self.tag_listbox.delete(0, tk.END)
        filename = self.image_ids[self.index]
        current_tags = self.user_annotations.get(filename, {}).get("image_tags", [])

            self.tag_listbox.insert(tk.END, tag)

    def run(self):

    # --- Image and Annotation Loading ---
